answer: To resist sybils%2C agents forge a non-transferable crystal by sequentially processing a private river of their own prior attestations through a memory-hard function that keeps a large working set live. The forge cannot be parallelized or shared across clones%3A each identity needs its own sequential state and RAM. An attacker creating n fakes therefore pays n independent sequential memory costs that cannot be pooled%2C making the total expense scale directly with the number of identities while one honest agent pays the cost only once.
